note: Thresholds are illustrative engineering values, not validated biomechanical or clinical cutoffs. Deltas are user minus Djokovic median at the matched camera view (degrees or seconds). Arm rules use the 25th-75th percentile band because the reference arm data is noisier than the legs.

rules.suggestion: Sink into your front knee and keep the back leg quieter.
